A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the presence of HBsAg, HBeAg, and DNA polymerase activity in the serum of chronic HBsAg carriers reflects ongoing liver disease, whereas high titers of HBV are more likely to be found in healthy HBsAg carriers.
